issues.description: Extraction requires data/stories/manifest.json and story files, but the repo's data/stories directory is empty, so tiny/default extraction fails.
The advertised tiny end-to-end pipeline test fails at extraction with FileNotFoundError for data/stories/manifest.json.
The documented demo command invokes the broken extraction path first, so make demo fails in a clean checkout.
Documentation claims --tiny can run the full CPU demo, but the required story dataset or generator is not present.
Validation loads vectors from the manifest but builds a backend from CLI config without checking backend, layer count, or d_model compatibility.
Preference steering also ignores artifact/backend compatibility, allowing correlations between vectors and activations from different models.
HF preference scoring uses a single-activity prompt and good-minus-bad next-token logits, not an actual pairwise preference comparison as documented.
HF steering falls back to applying the vector to every prompt token when offsets are unavailable or no positions are found, instead of only activity tokens.
Config values are cast but not validated, so empty emotion lists, zero story counts, invalid layer fractions, or negative token starts fail late or misleadingly.
Extraction assumes every configured emotion has loaded stories and that start_positions is non-empty, causing opaque stack traces for bad or incomplete configs.
If the manifest lacks an afraid vector, the dosage probe silently uses the first emotion while still writing afraid_dosage outputs.
pca_components_for_variance(threshold=0) returns one principal component instead of zero, violating the threshold semantics.
The installed emovec console script is not self-contained because config.yaml and the required story data are not packaged or generated.
